data.one_liner: Http inspector and logger for Dio and Http packages with UI and local sqlite storage.
data.what_it_does: Logs every HTTP request, response, and error for Dio and Http clients, stores them locally using SQLite, and provides an out-of-the-box activity page UI to inspect them.
use_when: You want to inspect HTTP requests, responses, and errors directly inside your Flutter app using a visual UI.
You need to log network activities for both Dio and the standard http package.
avoid_when: You only need console logging without any in-app visual UI.
You are using an HTTP client other than Dio or the standard http package.
strengths: Supports both Dio and http packages.
Includes built-in Material 3 and dark mode UI for inspecting network traffic.
weaknesses: Relies on manual navigation setup or GlobalKey configuration to open the inspector UI.
Limited to Dio and standard http package clients.
data.setup_notes: Call NetworkInspector.initialize() after WidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized(), and add the respective interceptor to your Dio or http clients.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only use Dio and prefer pretty console logging over an in-app visual UI.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more comprehensive logging and error-handling ecosystem with a dedicated Flutter screen.
